name: tmux
description: Tmux utilities for dispatching tasks to agents in other panes and reporting results back.

interface.shortDescription: Dispatch tasks to agents in other tmux panes and report back.
interface.longDescription: Utilities for inter-pane agent collaboration in tmux: dispatch a task to an agent in another pane with a reply channel stamped into the message, and report results back to the pane that dispatched it.
defaultPrompt: Use tmux:tmux_dispatch to send this task to the agent in tmux pane %7.
Use tmux:tmux_reply to report the result back to the pane that dispatched this task.
